takeoff.notes: Architectural ground floor plan with clear printed dimensions. Floor and ceiling areas are sum of the three rooms using printed clear sizes: Living 4.00x6.00=24.00 m2, Kitchen 3.85x2.50=9.625 m2, Bedroom 3.85x3.35=12.8875 m2. Wall_length is total wall centreline length: external rectangle taken at centreline = (8.00+0.15) by (6.00+0.15) giving perimeter 28.60 m; internal partitions centreline lengths 6.00 m + 3.85 m = 9.85 m; total 38.45 m. Wall_area is gross internal wall face area at 3.00 m height without any deductions: interior perimeter faces 2*(8+6)=28 m -> 84.0 m2 plus both faces of internal partitions 2*(6.00+3.85)=19.7 m -> 59.1 m2; total 143.1 m2. Door/window areas are from the printed opening schedule. No terraces/voids. Uncertainties: external wall centreline perimeter derived by adding 0.15 m to clear inside spans; if external overall dimensions differ, wall_length will change. Wall_area is gross (no deductions for openings). Finishes not specified. Review by QS required.

spaces.evidence: Printed 3.85 x 3.35 m (to right of vertical wall)
Wall thickness 0.15 m; clear spans 3.85 m with 2.50 m (kitchen) above and 3.35 m (bedroom) below

area_geometry.envelope_evidence: Overall clear inside: 8.00 m (top note) x 6.00 m (left). Walls 0.15 m thick.

quantities.evidence: Room tags: LIVING ROOM, KITCHEN, BEDROOM
Vertical partition 6.00 m + horizontal partition 3.85 m (centreline)
External centreline rectangle: (8.00+0.15) x (6.00+0.15) -> perimeter 2*(8.15+6.15)=28.60 m
External CL 28.60 m + internal CL 9.85 m
Sum of clear room areas: 24.00 + 9.625 + 12.8875 m2
Equal to enclosed walkable floor (no terraces)
